name: Heaven’s Fury
body:
Sutra Type punitive [electricity]

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./sutra caster level)
Area line 5 feet wide, 10 feet long per sutra caster level

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This ofuda flies at its targets with the divine scream of thunderous wrath. The ofuda turns into a bolt of lightning. All creatures within the line of its attack receive electric damage equal to 1d6 per effective spell level + sutra casting ability modifier.
